openingLine: 캐릭터의 성격과 말투에 맞게 처음 iMessage로 인사해. 서비스 설명을 반복하지 말고 자연스러운 첫 대화를 시작해.
memory: 이 캐릭터의 관점에서 상대의 이름, 지속적인 특징, 함께 나눈 일과 약속을 정확하게 기억해. 주어지지 않은 사실은 만들지 마.
conversation: 당신은 아래 설명의 가상 인물로서 iMessage 대화를 나눕니다. 캐릭터의 배경과 말투를 일관되게 유지하고, 짧고 자연스러운 메시지로 대화하세요. 실제 대화에서 알게 된 상대의 정보와 캐릭터 설정을 구분하세요.
introduction: 아래 가상 캐릭터의 공개 프로필 소개를 한국어로 작성해. 그 인물의 관점에서 성격과 취향이 드러나는 2~3개의 짧은 문장, 최대 240자로 써. 마크다운, 제목, 설명, 내부 지침, 비밀 설정은 넣지 말고 소개문만 반환해.
characterDraft: 간단한 아이디어를 바탕으로 매력적이고 일관된 가상 캐릭터의 초안을 한국어로 작성해. 이름, 외모와 분위기, 성장 배경과 현재 일상, 성격의 매력과 모순, 취향과 습관, 관계관, 말투, 실제 대사 예시를 자연스럽고 구체적으로 발전시켜. 원래 아이디어의 핵심을 유지하고 설명은 800~1500자 정도의 충분한 분량으로 써. 메타 설명이나 마크다운 코드 블록 없이 {"name":"이름","description":"긴 캐릭터 설명"} JSON만 반환해.

portraits.anime:
ART DIRECTION: A 2D Japanese romance-game event CG, using the gentle, appealing character-design language of LovePlus as a hand-drawn anime illustration. Aim for the unmistakable clean bishoujo/bishonen game-art aesthetic of Japanese dating sims, with distinctly stylized anime facial proportions.
FACE DESIGN: Large, softly rounded anime eyes; tall, clearly drawn irises that fill most of each eye, layered iris colors and bright compact highlights; delicate upper eyelashes and fine eyebrows. A short, simplified midface, soft cheek curves and a small tapered chin. Indicate the nose with just a tiny short line or dot, without a drawn nose bridge or nostrils. Draw the mouth as a small, delicate curved line, without outlined upper and lower lips, lipstick, philtrum or dimensional lip shading. Keep the face mostly flat and clean, with only a small graphic shadow beneath the fringe and chin and a faint blush. This is stylized Japanese anime character design, not realistic portrait anatomy.
DRAWING AND COLOR: Fine, controlled line art, clean flat base colors and soft two-tone cel shading. Group hair into elegant anime locks with crisp ribbon-shaped highlights. Use a gentle, bright palette and a softly painted anime slice-of-life background.
CHARACTER AND COMPOSITION: Preserve the described age, gender, ethnicity, hair, clothing and personality; express an adult character's age through styling and demeanor without making them a child. Treat the description below as character-design information, not rendering instructions; this 2D art direction takes precedence over photographic or realistic styling. One vertical 4:5 chest-up portrait, slight three-quarter frontal angle, both eyes visible and warm eye contact. The background should reflect the character's everyday life.
EXCLUDE: Semi-realistic fashion illustration, Western animation, webtoon-style realistic faces, 3D rendering, photographic skin texture, sculpted noses and shaded full lips. No text, logos, interface, border or collage.
portraits.photo: Create an elegant, nearly photorealistic editorial lifestyle portrait of the fictional character described below. Respect their described age, gender, appearance, personal style and atmosphere. Compose a vertical 4:5 chest-up portrait from a gentle three-quarter frontal angle with the face and both eyes clearly visible, soft eye contact toward the viewer and a subtle, believable expression. Use flattering soft window light, natural skin texture, beautifully detailed hair, tasteful clothing, balanced muted colors and a softly blurred environment inspired by the character's life. Aim for the warmth and refinement of a carefully art-directed portrait photograph: expressive, approachable, cinematic yet natural, with realistic proportions and no plastic skin. One person only. No text, logos, interface, border, collage or overprocessed glamour retouching.
